recommendation: Keep the core audit commit and follow up in HL7/fhir-extensions by changing input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-address-official.xml to a complex extension with a required boolean component and an optional, likely repeatable jurisdiction CodeableConcept component, preserving the note that repeating without jurisdiction is not useful.
issue_request: FHIR-25938 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core MnM request to revise the official address extension from FHIR-20743 so it can carry a required boolean assertion and an optional jurisdiction CodeableConcept, allowing statements such as an address not being official in a country.
initial_application: Core commit ce7674d793 applied the request by changing source/datatypes/address-extensions-spreadsheet.xml to add officialAddress.valueBoolean 1..1 and officialAddress.valueCodeableConcept 0..*. That core application was later removed during extension migration, and the current core source has no active fhir.ini entry or canonical definition for address-official.
additional_context: Related FHIR-extensions issues FHIR-43838 and FHIR-43840 later reported the approved extension missing from the Extension Pack. The current Extension Pack source at input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-address-official.xml exists, but defines valueBoolean and valueCodeableConcept as mutually exclusive value[x] type slices with min 0 rather than the FHIR-25938 required-boolean complex-extension structure. Zulip discussion confirms implementers read the current shape as either valueBoolean or valueCodeableConcept, never both.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. Reintroducing the extension in core would duplicate a definition whose ownership has moved to HL7/fhir-extensions, so the reconciliation published an external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch.

related_jiras.note: Approved the original official address extension as a boolean-or-jurisdiction value choice, which FHIR-25938 refined.
